description: This file defines an Express.js router for analytics-related endpoints in a Node.js backend application. It configures routes for health checks, cost metrics by agent, and new user statistics, protected by authentication and tenant verification middleware.

methods.name: head('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Defines a health check endpoint for LLM cost by agent, returning status 204 with specific headers.

methods.name: options('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS requests for the LLM cost endpoint, returning status 204.

methods.name: get('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: GET endpoint to retrieve LLM cost data by agent, protected by authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: get('/users/new-over-time')
methods.description: GET endpoint to retrieve new user statistics over time, protected by authentication and tenant verification.
